# Checkbox
Checkbox — turns a single option on or off, or selects several items from a list.

USE WHEN
· Several options can be chosen independently.
· One opt-in needs explicit consent (terms, remember me).
· A parent row summarises children that are only partly selected → Checked=indeterminate.

DON’T USE WHEN
· The choice takes effect immediately with no save → Switch.
· Exactly one option from a set → RadioGroup.
· The control performs an action → Button.

DO
· Always pair with a Label; clicking the label must toggle the box.
· Keep the focus ring on the box, never on the whole row.
· Put one error message below the group, not on every row.
· Write labels as positive statements ("Send me updates", not "Don’t send me updates").

DON’T
· Don’t use indeterminate as a third value a person can pick — it is a summary only.
· Don’t nest more than one level of parent/child.
· Don’t signal the error state with colour alone.
· Don’t reorder options between renders; keep a stable order.

PROPERTIES
Checked: unchecked · checked · indeterminate → React `checked`.
Size: sm · md · lg → React `size`.
State: documentation only (hover · focus-visible · active · disabled) — not a prop.

TOKENS  border · primary (checked fill) · danger (error) · focus-ring · radius-sm
CODE    <Checkbox> in @atlas/ui-web/primitives/Checkbox
